name: Fennel the Gardener
conversations: Shh. I'm listening to the trees. They're gossiping about the wind again.
Don't worry, they like you. That one's just being polite. But that one really likes you.
Things grow a little slower every year, you know. Not much. About a whisker. You'd only notice if you'd been counting whiskers for forty years.
Which I have. Someone's got to.
My gran used to say every tree on every island is a cousin of the Great Tree. Distant cousins. The sort you only see at festivals.
So I water them all the same. Family's family, even the prickly ones. Especially the prickly ones.
Leafwind sends seeds on the breeze. Seedhaven sends them in envelopes, with little thank-you notes.
I plant the seeds and keep the notes. Mostly I keep the notes.
